name: Thyme
description: Thyme is the herb (normal vegetative parts) of a species of plants in the genus Thymus, aromatic perennial evergreen herbs used for culinary, medicinal, and ornamental purposes.
uses: A staple ingredient in bouquet garni for stews and soups.
Possesses natural antibacterial and antifungal properties.
Soothing for sore throats when brewed as a warm tea.
imageAlt: A thyme sprig with tiny green leaves and small pink flowers.
